notes.title: New Patch! Menu Scaling, Adjustments, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p][b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC 
v1.3.2.6225 - 9/11/25

[/b]Today's patch brings some small visual and stability improvements to the game. Please read below to see the changes, and keep an eye out for some big surprises coming soon!

[b]WHAT'S NEW:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We have decreased the scaling of the game's menus and GUI on both tablets and the Steam version, as they appeared overly large on bigger screens. On the Steam version, we have also added a setting where you can change the menu and interface scaling yourself.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We have zoomed out the in-game camera somewhat on tablets and the Steam version, so that you can now see more of the castle at once while playing on bigger screens.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The "More Roomkin" Baddie Bonus now stacks properly when two or more Spoils with it are equipped at the same time[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed being able to see underneath the ground/game world in Chapter 1 when using the Giant Boulder of Doom[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Evilstein now responds with a more appropriate scolding message when trrying to place a trap on the same tile as a junk pile[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the new Day 7 "Blackstone" reward in the Daily Login screen not unlocking retroactively for some players who had progressed past the associated week before downloading the previous patch[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that would sometimes occur after shields were eaten by the Slimy Tentacles[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving us a review on our Steam page, as this greatly helps with the game's success and will help support us as we work on future content updates!
[/p]

notes.title: NEW TRAP: The Axe-o-Matic is here!
notes.content:
[p][b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC  v1.3.0 Build 6138 - 8/27/25[/b] 

We hope you enjoy our newest trap: the Axe-o-Matic! Read on to learn more about it and the other changes in this update, and as always: thank you for playing Castle Doombad!

[b]WHAT'S NEW:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The Axe-o-Matic has arrived! This new trap is our first "Hybrid" trap. It can be manually-aimed after placement, but then proceeds to fire automatically. This is the game's 32nd tarp, and you'll find it in the Auto Traps section. New Reskins have also been added for the Axe-o-Matic.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added our 40th achievement: "Axpertise"[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]New unique "Day 7" Daily Login Rewards have been added after Login Week 4![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]We have updated the look of Hero and Trap health bars in the game, and for the first time we've added health bars for Hero Shields. New options to toggle these off have also been added ot the settings screen.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Updated the "Mental Reset" Baddie Bonus fx and audio to be more noticeable when the effect triggers[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] [b]BUG FIXES:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a math error causing the "Reach Wave 5 in 6 Minutes" scheme in Roguevenge to accidentally require a time of 5 minutes instead of 6[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the "Basic Badness II" Baddie Bonus to sometimes not function[/p][p] [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue involving multiple stat-modifying Baddie Bonuses equipped simultaneously not stacking/working together in certain conditions[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a calculation issue with the completion % total for the Summer of Slays Event[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Not Enough Currency" pop-up would sometimes be blank/ not include its intended content[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]On the Steam version, fixed the "R" keyboard key so it once again toggles the Recycling Bin[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: More Summer Event Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Castle Doombad Classic
v1.2.4 Build 5999 - 8/12/25[/b]

The Summer of Screams continues! Today's patch includes several improvements and fixes. Check them out, and be sure to keep an eye out for some new surprises coming soon!

[b]WHAT'S NEW:[/b]

[list]
[*] New Evil Schemes added to Roguevenge that allow the unlocking of an additional Blackstone and Whitestone. Greenstones can now also appear as rewards via new repeatable Daily Schemes.
[*] Added a new song to the Summer Event's Beach Radio Spoil (in preparation for the next trap coming soon to the game!)
[*] We've performed several notable performance improvement measures including a game engine update and key asset optimization. Players on lower-end devices should experience a general performance boost.
[/list]

[b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Basic Badness" Baddie Bonus now increases damage by 3% instead of 2%, and "Basic Badness II" now increases damage by 6% instead of 3%
[*] "Scareoscopic" Baddie Bonus now increases damage by 6% instead of 3%
[*] "Third Time's the Harm" Baddie Bonus effect duration increased to 33 seconds, up from 13 seconds
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the "Crown all Summer Event Stages" Event Quest getting stuck or reset for some players
[*] FIxed some Summer Event Quests sometimes getting stuck or resetting progress
[*] Fixed the final revealable item in the Summer Event Shop linking to an incorrect Spoil in the previous version
[*] Fixed several Nightmares sometimes not functioning in Roguevenge in certain conditions, including More Roomkin, Parcel Panic, Scare Tactics, and Sinister Security
[/list]

notes.title: The Summer of Screams Event!
notes.content:
[p][b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC 
v1.2.0 - 7/25/25[/b] 

Welcome to Castle Doombad's "Summer of Screams" Event! We hope you enjoy this scorchingly sinister update! 

[b]NEW IN THE SUMMER EVENT:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Summer has come to Castle Doombad! Tap the orange EVENT button on the Main Menu to enter the event and get your summer on! This event is available until September 22nd[/p][/*][*][p]The Summer Event comes with special new event activities! New daily REWARDS, daily QUESTS, and full-event quests are available. All event quests can be completed in any game mode![/p][/*][*][p]6 NEW STAGES have been added as part of the Summer Event! Access them from the event's "Stages "tab. And yes, they're crownable![/p][/*][*][p]Over 30 new Summer Event rewards have been added, available for a limited time! The newly added Spoils also include new Baddie Bonus types.[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]OTHER ADDITIONS:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Introducing: Roguevenge Stones! Equip Roguevenge Stones to your traps to manipulate their chances of appearing during your runs. This feature unlocks after completing Night 1 in Roguevenge.[/p][/*][*][p]On the Steam version, the Trap Shelf now displays each trap's keyboard shortcut.[/p][/*][*][p]In Roguevenge, added additional fx and visual polish to the initial castle reveal sequence and the digging underground castle expansion sequence,[/p][/*][*][p]Events Spoils now include a special event icon when viewed in the Spoils Screen. (Unlocked Event Spoils stay unlocked past the event/forever),[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Troopkins have had their damage output slightly increased,[/p][/*][*][p]The buzzsaw has had its crit rate reduced, as it as higher than intended,[/p][/*][*][p]The "Slaycation Wallpaper"'s Baddie Bonus has changed from "Pyrofancy" to a new bonus called "Lit Crits",[/p][/*][*][p]The "Winter Blunderland" Baddie Bonus is now 1 Muahaha Slot, down from 2[/p][/*][*][p]The "So Pointy" Baddie Bonus is now 1 Muahaha Slot instead of 2, and the damage % has been incresed.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sparkkin has received a small reduction to their initial damage[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]BUGFIXES:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]This update includes numerous stability improvements, specifically fixes to situational errors that could sometimes occur in various parts of the game and cause issues such as soft locks or crashes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Randomize Traps feature sometimes not activating the Play button the first time it's used, and also fixed the Equipped label spoiling which traps were selected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Fire Doomkins were sometimes not applying the fire/burn effect to heroes
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you as always for playing Castle Doombad! If you enjoy the game and have a moment, it helps us greatly to receive User Reviews on Steam! Please also keep an eye out for more content coming soon (including our next new Trap (the Axe-o-Matic), the new-and-improved Endless Mode, and more surprises!)[/p]

notes.title: Updates to Spoils Screen, Spoils Favoriting, Fixes, and more!
notes.content:
[b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC 
v0.9.4968 - 5/22/25[/b]

Hello, villains! Today we have an update that brings some Quality of Life improvements to the game. Read on to find out more, and thanks as always for playing Castle Doombad!

[b]WHAT'S NEW[/b]

[list]
[*] The Spoils Screen has received numerous updates and improvements, including a new "Active Baddie Bonuses" dynamic list (which you can also tap to shortcut to associated Spoils), Baddie Bonuses now show their Muahaha Slot requirement even when disabled, improvements to the feel of the scroller menu, and several visual organizational changes have also been applied.
[*] You can now "favorite" your Spoils with the Black Heart button, located in the top right corner of their description. Favorited Spoils can be accessed with a new filter option on the Spoils Screen.
[*] You can now see any trap's complete upgrade list with the new "i" button on the Trap Select Screen, found on the right side of each trap's infobox. (Even traps that you haven't unlocked yet)
[*] We have adjusted a few of the randomized castle floor designs that can appear in Roguevenge to be more fair when they are used for the Princess Chamber floor. We have also added several new possible castle floor designs/layouts to Roguevenge.,
[*] Added the "Updates" button on the Title Screen, which will allow players to now read these patch notes in-game
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the "Obtain 6 traps" scheme sometimes not completing properly in Roguevenge,
[*] Fixed the "Build the castle to 10 floors" scheme sometimes not completing properly in Roguevenge,
[*] Fixed the "Daily Login Rewards" screen getting stuck at the end of a week and not advancing to the next week for some players,
[*] Fixed visual weirdness with the "Third Time's the Harm" Baddie Bonus activation particle effect,
[*] Fixed the junk pile and glint progress radial sometimes getting stuck if the player starts to move the camera while it's visible,
[*] Fixed several minor localization text mistakes/issues,
[*] Performed several performance and stability improvements. We are planning to implement more in the near future.
[/list]

If you have any issues, please let us know either in the game's store page discussion forum, or by reaching out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/Nw2pMsMUvz]our discord server[/url]. If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving us a store review, as these really help us out! 

Thanks and see ya next patch!

notes.title: Medkin, Daily Challenges, and Localization Update!
notes.content:
Hey Steam Villains!

We know it's been awhile, but we're happy to say: we're BACK with a BIG BAD UPDATE for [b]Castle Doombad Classic[/b]! This one is packed full of devious delights, including a brand new trap, new control options, new daily challenge mode, localization into 14 different languages, and much more! Read on for full details:

[b]WICKED NEW FEATURES!:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now pan the camera vertically with your mouse scroll wheel! (A sensitivity setting is also available in the settings screen)
[*] The number keys on the keyboard can now be used as a secondary method for selecting traps from the trap shelf
[*] New Trap Added: Return of the Medkin (Medic Doomkin)! Keep your other traps and minions healed with the power of... evil love?
[*] Daily Challenges are here! Try your evil hand at daily special gameplay modes like Trap Randomizer, Protect the Doomkin, and many more!
[*] Daily Login Rewards have also been added! Launch the game for new rewards every day, including unique Spoils! (Your login days don't need to be consecutive!)
[*] 24 new Reskins, 14 new Spoils, 6 New Baddie Bonuses, and 10 New Nightmares have been added! Find and collect them all!
[*] Castle Doombad is now localized into 14 different languages! You can change the game's language in the settings screen
[/list]

[b]CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Roguevenge Mode's balance has been re-tuned (AND includes a few new special guest appearances...)
[*] Main Menu navigation has received numerous updates and improvements, including now allowing access to the Traps and Spoils screens from the main menus
[*] You can now view your To-Dooms, Schemes, and Achievements outside of stages. This new pop-up menu is accessible from the “trophy button” located in the top left corner of the screen on the main menus and in the Trap Select Screen.
[*] Spoils have now been assigned rarity/quality tiers, designated by the color of their name 
[*] Four fiendish new achievements have been added!
[/list]

[b]BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS - TRAPS & BADDIE BONUSES:[/b][list]
[*] We sent the Troopkin back to basic training, and they’ve undergone a big revamp! As a result, Troopkin rebuild rate and scream cost have been greatly reduced. Their attack power and accuracy were also increased. 
[*] Doomkins have received a reaction time rework and should now be smarter and more attentive!
[*] The Wacky Tube Man and the Laser Shark can now be targeted/attacked by normal heroes and not just dismantlers
[*] The Laser Shark must now finish chewing before the laser gets charged (the previous behavior was unintentional)
[*] Laser Blaster damage has been increased by 15%
[*] The Wacky Tube Man has received a 15% health increase
[*] "Cost Control" Baddie Bonus now refunds more screams on use, and requires 2 Muahaha Slots, up from 1
[*] "North Polenishment" Baddie Bonus effect increased to 20%, up from 15%
[*] "Baddie Berries Cereal" and "Doomkin Painting" spoils now have the new "Doomy Snacks" Baddie Bonus, replacing "Expiration Date" and "More Roomkin" bonuses
[*] The "Badlantir" Spoil now has the new "Illuminaughty" bonus, replacing "Pyrofancy"
[*] "Very Pointy Throne" and "Gold Pointy Crown" both now have the new "So Pointy" bonus, replacing "Scarefying" and "Diescount"
[*] "Bone Throne" now has the new "That Poison" bonus, replacing "Diescount"
[*] "Green Wall" now has the new "Lean Green" Baddie Bonus, replacing "Eerie Feary"
[*] "Scaling Up" Baddie Bonus now requires 2 Muahaha Slots, up from 1
[*] "Shock Therapy" now requires 2 Muahaha Slots, up from 1
[*] "Harvester of Souls" now requires 1 Muahaha Slot, down from 2
[*] "Scaling Up" now requires 2 Muahaha Slots, up from 1[/list]

[b]BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS - HEROES & MISC:[/b][list]
[*] Archer heroes have had their attack power increased
[*] The Commandbro has received a 10% reduction in attack power and health points
[*] Roguevenge Mode balance has been updated to be slightly easier in the first two waves, and somewhat more challenging in the later waves
[*] Roguevenge Mode now has reduced instances of somewhat unfair spawning behavior (strong heroes entering the castle right next to the princess). Note: we are currently still looking into further improvements and adjustments around this
[*] Roguevenge Power-Ups are now capped at holding up to 3 max at one time (per powerup type)
[*] The game's economy has undergone some minor adjustments across the board[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES:  
[/b][list]
[*] Resolved numerous instances of heroes getting stuck and becoming invulnerable, not dying when they should, or falling through the ground. (If you still encounter one of these, please let us know by using the “report an issue” button in the Extras screen)
[*] Fixed several instances of the Treadmill of Doom and The Boot breaking heroes during their transition states
[*] Fixed The Boot being able to kick heroes out of the castle or through walls
[*] Fixed an issue where Manual Traps would sometimes auto-trigger when being placed in the castle  
[*] You can now use the Recycling Bin to recycle the desired trap when multiple traps reside on a single tile. Also fixed an issue that prevented the recycling of ceiling traps in front of doors. 
[*] Fixed the Recycling Bin button sometimes unintentionally recycling a trap underneath the Recycle button when clicking it 
[*] Traps that previously did not show a healthbar when attacked, like the Scream Machine and the Wacky Tube Man, now do show healthbars
[*] Fixed Doomkins sometimes getting stuck and vibrating up and down, when they should've been attacking a hero. Bad Doomkin!!
[*] Fixed several instances of Schemes and To-Dooms not completing properly. Also now preventing some To-Dooms from completing when they shouldn’t.
[*] Fixed Evilstein's starting dialogue not playing at the beginning of new chapters in Classic Mode
[*] Fixed Heebie Jeebies and Eerie Feary Baddie Bonuses not applying their effects correctly 
In Roguevenge, fixed not being able to interact with Manual Traps placed in front of Wall Soul Cases
[*] The Spinning Fireball Thingie and the Laser Blaster will no longer have issues after being recycled
[*] In Roguevenge, fixed an issue where the pile of rocks on the first floor sometimes wouldn’t be removed after a basement floor was added, and traps like the Acid Dripper would not pass through it.
[*] Fixed strange behavior resulting from Troopkins attacking heroes on treadmills
[*] Fixed Hunky Knights sometimes taking questionable paths through the castle, especially when carrying the princess or a Decoy Princess. Also fixed them sometimes exiting through walls…
[*] The Laser Shark’s laser beam will no longer sometimes stop short. (The laser also now includes Screen Shake!)  
[*] Fixed The Zapper and the Toxic Vent not utilizing its HD textures 
[*] In the Spoils Screen, the Baddie Bonus button now correctly lists the number of active bonuses (it was accidentally showing slot count instead of number of bonuses)
[*] In The Spoils Screen, your Baddie Bonus list will no longer display doubled up bonuses that aren’t actually active (like when you duplicate the same Spoil on the floor, wall, or desk)
[*] Fixed infinite loop when the Ninja jumps to leave the Dungeon and Space chapter levels.
[*] Fixed the Spinning Fireball Thingie losing a fireball at max upgrade
[*] Fixed an issue where opening the spoils UI through the chapter select causes the tap to also register on chapter select and break the interactions
[*] The “Flip Trap” button now shows the depletion highlight correctly, rather than being inverted
[*] Fixed duplicated Spoils (like placing the same Spoil in both wall, floor, or desk spots) also duplicating Baddie Bonuses, as this was never intended (and bypassed the Muahaha Slots system). (Baddie Bonuses of the same type can still stack if they are on different Spoil types)
[*] Various other small fixes and improvements

Please keep an eye out for more Doombad updates and new content, coming soon! If you enjoy the game, please help us out by leaving a Steam Review. Thanks for playing Castle Doombad!!

notes.title: Castle Doombad Classic v0.9.3526 (Minor bugfix patch 3)
notes.content:
[b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC - Minor Bugfix Patch 3
v0.9.3526 - 1/7/25[/b]

We hope you had a nice holiday and a happy new year! A new patch is now available for Steam players. Please read below for details:


[b]ADDITIONS & CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] 7 Brand new Achievements have been added, mostly centered around Roguevenge and the new Spoils system
[*] When the Princess is released from the Scream Chamber in Classic Mode, you can now retrieve her with the flying monkey by using the Evilness resource and a button at the top of the screen (this can only be activated once per stage). This feature was previously present in the original game[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a handful of achievements not working/triggering, and all achievements should now be working properly
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hunky Knight would become invisible if afflicted by the "chill" status effect before jumping up a ladder
[*] Fixed the "Neat Freak" Baddie Bonus on the Broom of Doom showing the wrong description text
[*] Fixed an issue where Space Madness chapter floors with the power generator would sometimes prevent placing Doomkins when they shouldn't have
[*] Fixed the "Build the castle to 7 floors" Evil Scheme in Roguevenge sometimes not completing properly
[*] Fixed Classic Mode stages after Chapter 1 not showing the Stage # as a header in the Trap Select Screen before stages
[*] Fixed the Chapter Select Screen camera centering on the Endless Knights chapter rather than the Space Madness chapter when exiting a Space Madness stage[/list]
We are will be continuing to add more new content and make more improvements and fixes, and we hope you'll look forward to it. If you have any feedback or would like to report any issues, please let us know in the Steam Discussion boards, on our Discord, or you can contact us at https://www.castledoombad.com


See ya next patch, Doombadders!

notes.title: Castle Doombad Classic v0.9.3325 (Minor bugfix patch 2)
notes.content:
Thank you again to all the helpful villains out there who have reported issues and provided feedback! Please read below for the new improvements in our Day 2 Bugfix patch:

[b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC - Minor Bugfix Patch 2
v0.9.3325 - 12/13/24[/b]

[b]ADDITIONS & CHANGES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added screenshake to explosions! You can turn off all screenshake in the accessibility section of the settings menu

[*] The Man of Teal (Superhero) can no longer fall through trap doors, and also now flies over rock piles rather than hopping
[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an audio issue where if the player hit the NEXT button in the Results Screen while the trap "energy bar fill" sounds were playing, they'd get stuck looping 

[*] Fixed an issue with the Trap Door where if heroes died at a specific moment while falling through, they'd get stuck in an invulnerable state in the castle, or otherwise soft lock the wave

[*] Fixed an issue where after completing all 30 To-Dooms and cycling back to old To-Dooms, they could get stuck in an automatic-completing cycle on the results screen

[*] Fixed the Decoy Princess from having wacky scale changes while being carried, and fixes instances of the explosion not doing damage
[/list]
We will be continuing to provide more improvements and fixes next week and beyond. If you have any feedback or would like to report any issues, please let us know in the Steam Discussion boards, on our discord, or you can contact us at www.castledoombad.com


See ya next patch!

notes.title: Castle Doombad Classic v0.9.3306 (Minor bugfix patch)
notes.content:
Thank you so much to our launch-day Doombadders for all your support, kind words, and feedback! We have a quick launch day patch that fixes a few issues, noted below. We hope you continue to enjoy the game, and keep an eye out for more improvements and updates coming soon!

[b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC - Minor Bugfix Patch
v0.9.3306 - 12/12/24

BUGFIXES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the launch gift "8bitkin" Doomkin reskin not being set to 0 Cruelpons. To redeem, press the "reskin" button while having the regular Doomkin highlighted in the Trap Select Screen, and then scrolling to the last reskin option. [i](Note: this reskin will only be set to 0 Cruelpons for launch week, afterwards it will increase to 20 Cruelpons if not already unlocked.)[/i]

[*] Now properly preventing interacting with pickups inside the castle during the Wave End Reward Arrow Choice sequence in Roguevenge, which was causing the wave sequence to break in some cases

[*] Fixed issue with Soul Cases in Roguevenge spawning multiple sets of drops when multiple Soul Cases were present simultaneously

[*] Now hiding the "Extend Trap Shelf" button in the Roguevenge Trap Select Screen until the player has unlocked it via the Classic Mode tutorial (stage 8), at which point it will be unhidden
[/list]
[b]OTHER NOTES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Two notable issues are still being fixed currently and will be patched asap: 1) If you hit "next" on the Results Screen quickly before the Trap Energy Bars finish filling, the fill sound effect will get stuck in a loop until you close the game, 2) if you kill a hero the moment they fall through the trap door, they will become invulnerable and float through the castle until you restart the stage.
[/list]
See you at the next patch!

notes.content:

Sinister status update! [b]Castle Doombad Classic[/b] is now releasing on [b]December 12, 2024.[/b]

notes.title: Castle Doombad Classic has been delayed to November 25th, 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102384/179ad3c6764039191d223b2b1a2748ae9fd43da1.png[/img]

Hey Doomfriends,

We’ve got some not-so-fun news to share. Unfortunately, we've made the difficult decision to delay [i]Castle Doombad Classic[/i] to[i][b] November 25th, 2024[/b][/i]. 

The reality is that we fell behind on our original timeline, which was always a bit ambitious for what we had planned  (we aimed for a Halloween release that we knew was going to be a little difficult to hit, simply because we loved the idea of serving up some spooky Doombad goodness for the holiday!). Rather than rushing the game out in an unfinished state to hit our original date, we thought it was better for the game and the players to delay.

But the good news behind this delay is that the new content we’re adding—especially the brand-new [i][b]Roguevenge Mode[/b][/i]—has grown into something bigger and better than we initially anticipated. As a result, it’s required more time and effort to pull off and perfect than we had originally planned. 

We sincerely apologize for pushing back the release dates and for the last-minute nature of this announcement. Please know that our team is working hard to bring you something fun, unique, and deliciously villainous—and you’ll have it in your hands very soon!

In the meantime, here’s some positive news:

Though Steam Next Fest is now complete, we've decided to leave the Castle Doombad Classic Demo up on Steam indefinitely for the time being, so you can still enjoy it while you wait for the full release. And, to thank you for your patience, we’re also offering a special bonus: the "8Bitkin" Doomkin reskin will automatically unlock for anyone who launches the game during the first week of release! (November 25th - December 2nd).

Thank you all for your continued support, and we hope you still have a fiendishly fun Halloween!

[NOTE: We originally made this announcement a week ago on our social media channels and discord, but held the announcement here on Steam due to needing extra time to finalize approval for the delay with Valve. We're very sorry that we were not able to share this news here until now/at the last minute.]

notes.title: Castle Doombad Classic - Demo Patch v0.9.1876
notes.content:
Hello doomfriends! Thank you to all of those who have tried out the first Castle Doombad Classic Demo! 

We are hoping to support this demo version with more bugfixes and improvements leading up to our launch, and possibly beyond. Thank you also to all of those who have submitted bug reports and feedback! Without further ado, here are the patch notes:

[b]CASTLE DOOMBAD CLASSIC - DEMO VERSION 
v0.9.1876 - 10/17/24[/b]
[b]
BALANCE CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trap Energy Bar cooldown increased from 2 stages to 3 stages for all traps
[/list]
[b]MINOR ADJUSTMENTS & ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now automatically closing the Recycling Bin after recycling a trap
[*] Now showing the Crit text and visuals when critical damage is applied to a hero
[*] Boomkins, Potato Trolls, and Floor Spikes now all show healthbars when attacked
[*] Adjusted the look of all healthbars
[/list]
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed various instances where reskinned traps would not properly show their reskins
[*] Fixed To-Doom challenges being broken
[*] Fixed issues with Commandbro jumping and wandering around aimlessly, and also fixed his sfx not playing
[*] Fixed some issues with various trap upgrades, including the Fire Doomkin not spawning and some traps not getting their scream cost reduced
[*] Fixed the Wacky Tube Man getting weaker when his attack power is upgraded
[*] Fixed issue with Chapter 2 appearing unlocked (but broken) when it shouldn't
[*] Fixed FX on the trap shelf for the Mega Scream power-up not appearing
[*] Fixed issue where a hero would become stuck if they hopped on the Treadmill of Doom next to a window after they entered via a siege ladder
[*] Hiding the Color Blind setting from the Accessibility options for now, because it's not ready yet (but will still be coming in the future)
[*] Fixed tutorials showing touch screen/mobile verbiage instead of keyboard/mouse verbiage when playing with keyboard/mouse
[*] Various other fixes and stability improvements
[/list]
